newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi, Toshiba tie up in Internet networking.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi, Toshiba tie up in Internet networking.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd and Toshiba Corp said on Thursday they had agreed to collaborate in providing high-speed networking products for the Internet and intranets.

Under the tie-up, the companies will provide each other with products and technologies for incorporating into own-brand products and systems, with the aim of establishing themselves as market leaders in the fast-expanding network business.
The shared products will include routers and switches used to connect computers, they said in a joint statement.
They also said they aimed to expand their cooperation in the future.
Hitachi will incorporate Toshiba's cell switch router technology in its asyncronous transfer mode (ATM) switch and local area network (LAN) switch, and will provide the products to Toshiba.
Toshiba will provide Hitachi with its cell switch router controller, which is expected to be put on the market in June.
A Hitachi spokeswoman, however, declined to say when they would market the first product developed under the tie-up.
